chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from Muʿammar ibn Khallād, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about salat (prayer) in khazz, and he said: “Pray in it.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the Imam giving the ruling
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act being asked about
key_terms.الْخَزِّ: khazz, a type of fabric or garment material under discussion for prayer
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked, indicating a direct legal inquiry
key_terms.صَلِّ: perform salat (pray), an imperative granting permission

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing khazz according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) in clothing made of khazz. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام permits praying in it, indicating its acceptability as attire for prayer.
